content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a way to make the numeric value appear larger within the analog value box in [product_name] Web Editor? [IMAGE] Best regards, [user_name]

The current version of [product_name] Web Editor doesn’t provide an option to adjust the size of numbers inside the analog value box. The next release, expected soon (version [version_no]), should include this functionality. For now, modifications are only possible if you have experience with HTML5.
Thank you for clarifying. Do you know if the update is planned for this month? Is it possible to edit the HTML file directly on the SD card for changes using HTML5?

No, the recommended approach is to finish your project and store it on your PC. Then, use an HTML5 editor on your computer to modify the web pages as needed. However, working with HTML5 is not my area of expertise. Only [company_name] knows the exact release date for [product_name] Web Editor version [version_no]; it could be this week, next month, or possibly later.

analysis.insight_summary: Users seek the ability to change numeric display size in the analog value box of [product_name] Web Editor, but the current version does not support this feature. There is awareness of an upcoming release that may add this capability and discussion on potential workarounds using HTML5 editing. Users are anticipating more customization options to improve visibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Web Editor's future versions to offer customization for numeric display size and want such changes to be simple or directly accessible. They are hoping for either a software update soon or a clear, practical method to adjust display elements for improved readability.
